Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a mass in the lower right lung field (indicated by the arrow) that appears to abut or involve the chest wall/breast region. In the context of clinical history often associated with such questions, a mass in this location is frequently indicative of a metastasis from a primary lung tumor extending to or presenting in the breast/chest wall, rather than a primary breast cancer or benign lesion.
